name: Earth

albedo.provider: NASA / GSFC Blue Marble Next Generation
albedo.title: July cloud-free land and ocean color
albedo.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Reto Stöckli, NASA GSFC
albedo.rights: NASA mission imagery; original credit retained
albedo.processing: 5400x2700 to 4K/2K/1K; no invented detail; water roughness mask inferred from observed blue water colors, not a measured mask; black water of BMNG filled with Blue Marble 2001 ocean color; derivative is a mixed-epoch visual composite
albedo.primeMeridianOrOrientationNotes: Equirectangular -180..180 east-positive; Greenwich at image center

oceanSource.title: 2001 ocean composite
oceanSource.rights: NASA mission imagery; original credit retained
oceanSource.processing: Fills black water pixels of July BMNG with observed ocean color; native 2048px ocean image
oceanSource.primeMeridianOrOrientationNotes: Absolute longitude not certified; IAU pole and rotation from NAIF PCK

additionalSources.title: Independent cloud composite
additionalSources.observationEpoch: 2001-era composite: two visible-light days plus polar thermal third day
additionalSources.rights: NASA mission imagery; original credit retained
additionalSources.processing: Luminance to opacity on independent shell 1.0015 R; fixed snapshot, no invented drift
additionalSources.primeMeridianOrOrientationNotes: Absolute longitude not certified; IAU pole and rotation from NAIF PCK

additionalSources.title: 2016 nighttime lights
additionalSources.credit: NASA Earth Observatory; VIIRS / Miguel Román team
additionalSources.rights: NASA mission imagery; original credit retained
additionalSources.processing: 3600x1800 grayscale emissive mask, warm display tint, strictly gated to night
additionalSources.primeMeridianOrOrientationNotes: Absolute longitude not certified; IAU pole and rotation from NAIF PCK

additionalSources.title: 2001 ocean composite
additionalSources.rights: NASA mission imagery; original credit retained
additionalSources.processing: Fills black water pixels of July BMNG with observed ocean color; native 2048px ocean image
additionalSources.primeMeridianOrOrientationNotes: Absolute longitude not certified; IAU pole and rotation from NAIF PCK

visualEnhancements: VISUAL_ENHANCEMENT: analytic thin atmospheric rim, approximate cloud shadows
RECONSTRUCTED: color-classified land/ocean roughness, warm non-radiometric city lights
VISUAL_ENHANCEMENT: optional UTC/TDB-driven cloud advection +3 degrees/day relative to IAU surface, anchored 2026-10-29; illustrative only, not meteorological data
limitations: Surface July 2004, clouds 2001 era, lights 2016: not selected-date weather or population
Cloud source 2048 and night source 3600; 4K derivatives do not add information
Generic IAU_EARTH rotation, no EOP/polar motion
No fabricated elevation or ocean-wave normal; cloud advection is illustrative and can be frozen
description: NASA 地表、独立云壳、薄大气与夜面灯光。云漂移是可关闭的示意，不是天气预测。
